Measured on an M3 Max (36 GB): one-second clip in 480p, about 7 GB; beyond 1.5 s memory gets tight, so longer clips (up to 20 s) are made in chained slices, each starting from the last frame of the previous one; the length of a slice follows the memory measured on the machine (short on the first try, then adjusted). Duration multiplied and motion may change from one slice to the next. The Q8_0 variant gains in fineness.
